### Problem

When the autopilot stops on a pull request that is already ready for review (`needs-human` from a fix round), a maintainer's answer in words does not bring it back, although the stop comment says it does ("a maintainer's answer here, a hint in words, brings it back"). The answer starts an "Autopilot (continue)" run whose "may it run" step answers "Next step: none: ready for review: the review runs at its head" and "No continue: #N is not an open draft", and nothing else picks the answer up: the pull request stays stopped until a check fails again at a new head (#973) or someone re-runs the failed job by hand. Seen twice on 2026-11-23/24 in DiluxOne/diluxone-fm: #321 (answered at 22:01Z, Issues run 45275574963, only moved after its branch was updated and "Test first" failed again) and #314 (its fix round's work job died on the runner, run 45340585768; the answer at 06:48Z gave Issues run 45343252194 with the same "not an open draft").

### Scope

- An answer from someone who decides, on a ready pull request the autopilot stopped (`needs-human` on its board), starts a fix round that reads the answer, as it does for a draft.
- An answer on a ready pull request that is not stopped keeps behaving as today.

### Out of scope

- Why the work job died on the runner.
- Re-runs of failed checks.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given a ready autopilot pull request stopped with `needs-human` after a fix round, when someone who decides answers in words, then a fix round starts with the answer in its prompt.
- C2: Given a ready autopilot pull request that is not stopped, when someone comments, then no fix round starts, as today.
- C3: Given a stopped draft, when someone who decides answers, then it continues as today.

### Criticality

Normal
